Kind and caring team who have always been there for our two cats!

EDIT: unfortunately I have had some difficulties recently with what should be some simple administrative matters. It has taken a month and a half for them to dispatch flea and deworming treatments for my cats - despite me calling multiple times! The treatments are still not dispatched!

Their vet is not registered with the FCDO, I got the EHC from them then went to get it legalised in order to travel I was extremely shocked to know that EHC was rejected from FCDO because their vet is not registered. Had to pay last minute to a pet shipping company to allow my cat to travel. Basically lost a lot of money around 280 pounds from this clinic and 480 from the pet shipping company. Now they do not want to respond to my emails as I’m asking for a refund

Dear Natasha, 
Thank you so much for giving us 5 stars. We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review. 

Kind regards,
The London Cat Clinic team

We’ve been bringing our cat Taro here for the last 5 years, and I couldn't ask for a better veterinary team. They are professional, deeply knowledgeable, equipped with the top-notch medical equipment, and clearly care about the cats they treat. Sadly we will be moving and won’t be able to come back for routine health checks. Thank you very much for giving such great care to Taro. I wish the team all the best.

Dear Peter, 
Thank you very much for taking the time to leave us 5 stars. We look forward to seeing you again. 
Kind regards,
The London Cat Clinic team
A 10-min walk from the Bermondsey Station. The veterinary doctor who looked after my cat was very kind and helpful.

Dear Ayla, 

Thank you very much for leaving us a 5 star review. 

Kind regards, 
The London Cat Clinic Team.
Lovely vet, they made my cat very comfortable, explained his condition very well and gave best care, its such a lovely environment would recommend this place to bring your cat for care!

They've been taking such amazing care of my lovely boy for the past year. He's a senior cat and his health deteriorated last year. He's had numerous procedures, reviews, treatments. The team is incredible and the clinic is literally designed for cats, down to the smallest detail. My cat has never been "nice" with any vet staff before, yet he's such a sweetheart when he goes for his follow ups, gets cuddles and treats from everyone there and simply feels safe. This clinic is pretty far away from us and even with the added uber costs, I wouldn't go anywhere else. It is more pricey than your usual vet, but their expertise and the way they treat my cat is unmatched. Wish I had found them sooner.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at the London Cat Clinic.

Over the course of my cat’s treatment, I felt that unnecessary charges were repeatedly added while new problems were constantly identified without practical solutions being offered. At every visit, I was told to “be patient,” yet each appointment resulted in additional costs with little progress.

I spent nearly £3,000 on investigations, but I never felt that there was a clear treatment plan or that my options were explained properly. The main recommendation seemed to be changing my cat’s food repeatedly, rather than providing a practical solution to the underlying problem.

My biggest concern was the experience with my cat’s spay surgery. My cat was returned without the procedure being completed, and I was then presented with an additional bill of around £1,500 after I was told that a visiting dental specialist had identified another issue. This was unexpected and left me feeling that the situation had not been handled transparently.

Overall, I felt that communication was poor, costs were not explained clearly in advance, and my concerns were not taken seriously. I left feeling frustrated, financially drained, and without confidence that my cat received the care and transparency I expected.

Based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend this clinic.
